_comment: Adjudicated tool diagnostic IDs (vibe-ic#1081). An ID listed here is one a
human LOOKED AT and decided we accept, so `tool_diagnostic_id_gate.py` does
not block on it appearing for the first time.
THIS LIST IS ITSELF CHECKED. `audit_acceptance()` blocks on three things,
because an allowlist nobody re-examines becomes a check that lies:
1. MALFORMED - every entry needs id, reason, accepted_on, expires_on and
adjudicated_by. An exemption nobody signed or dated is not an
adjudication, it is a silence with a JSON key.
2. EXPIRED - past `expires_on` is BLOCKING, not auto-renewed and not
quietly dropped. Expiry has to cost something or it is decoration.
3. STALE - the ID is emitted nowhere in the current run. An exemption
that outlived the diagnostic it excused is the same shape
`retention.json` already blocks on for published cells.
DELIBERATELY EMPTY ON ARRIVAL, AND ON THIS COMMIT IT CANNOT BE OTHERWISE.
Re-measured on 4b22e36ea (v1.10.32): the gate was run over ALL FIVE published
cells this commit carries and every one exits 2 NO_BASELINE, because no design
carries two cells of the same PDK and `find_previous` requires same-PDK plus a
strictly lower version. So there is no un-adjudicated ID to seed here: the
comparison path is unreachable from today's corpus.
AN EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS FILE CLAIMED OTHERWISE and the claim is withdrawn
rather than quietly edited. It read that `spm/v1.9.94_sky130A` vs
`v1.5.65_sky130A` emits DRT-0290, EST-0015, ODB-0220, STA-0168, STA-0198, and
that `spm/v1.9.96_gf180mcuD` adds DRT-0349, DRT-0701, PSM-0079. Neither
`v1.9.94_sky130A` nor `v1.5.65_sky130A` exists in this repository, and
`v1.9.96_gf180mcuD` has no predecessor of its PDK, so it cannot add anything -
it exits 2. Those ids are real shapes (STA-0168 and STA-0198 are `Warning 168:`
and `Warning 198:` in the aging_sta/power reports), but the COMPARISON that was
said to surface them never ran here.
The reason that matters: the point of shipping this empty was that the author
must not adjudicate his own finding. That still holds, and now it holds for a
checkable reason instead of an uncheckable one. When a second same-PDK cell is
published, the gate will produce a real list and someone with the standing to
accept an id can write a reason and a date.
Shape of an entry:
{"id": "RSZ-0062", "reason": "why we accept it",
"adjudicated_by": "who decided"}
